title.en: European High-Risk Medical Devices and IVD Catalogue Ontology

description.en: Ontology for representing medical devices, IVD devices, manufacturers, risk classes, risks, incidents and field safety corrective actions based on the CSV files provided in the PEC.

comments.en: Ontology created for a university assignment on semantic web and knowledge representation.

source.value: CSV files provided in the PEC: dispositivos, fabricantes, riesgos, incidentes and acciones correctivas.

bibliographicCitation.value: David. European High-Risk Medical Devices and IVD Catalogue Ontology. Version 1.0.0, 2026.
